# Accessibility Design Review: Modal Dialog Component **VERDICT: ACCEPT-WITH-RESERVATIONS** **Overall Assessment**: The `Modal` component implements a robust, thoughtful foundation for the WAI-ARIA Dialog (Modal) pattern. Focus trapping, focus restoration (with re-render resilience), Escape key handling, and background click guarding are implemented with high attention to edge cases. However, critical gaps exist around background tree occlusion (missing inert/`aria-hidden` sibling isolation), fallback focus when children contain no interactive elements, and hardcoded element IDs leading to duplicate DOM collisions. --- ### Pre-commitment Predictions 1. **Focus restoration**: Often fragile during parent unmount or re-render *(Result: Handled well via separate refs and cleanup)*. 2. **Focus trapping & boundary containment**: Often fails when clicking non-focusable dialog text *(Result: Specifically guarded and handled)*. 3. **Background accessibility tree leaking**: Screen readers navigating via virtual cursor/rotor reaching unhidden background nodes behind `aria-modal="true"` *(Result: Confirmed gap; background DOM is not marked `inert` or `aria-hidden`)*. 4. **Zero-focusable elements inside dialog**: Focus trap locking or losing initial focus when children have no interactive elements *(Result: Confirmed gap; dialog container lacks `tabIndex={-1}` fallback)*. 5. **Static ID collisions**: Multiple instances causing duplicate `id="modal-title"` *(Result: Confirmed gap)*. --- ### Critical Findings (blocks access) *No blocking access failures that completely trap keyboard users or prevent core screen reader operation under normal conditions.* --- ### Major Findings (significantly degrades experience) #### 1. Background Content Not Isolated via `inert` or `aria-hidden` - **Location**: `Modal.jsx:136-167` - **Impacted Group**: Screen reader users (VoiceOver, NVDA, TalkBack). - **Criterion**: [WCAG 2.4.3 Focus Order](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/focus-order), [WCAG 1.3.2 Meaningful Sequence](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/meaningful-sequence), [WAI-ARIA APG Dialog (Modal) Pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/dialog-modal/). - **Why this matters**: While `aria-modal="true"` informs assistive technology that the dialog is modal, browser and screen reader support (especially VoiceOver iOS/macOS and older NVDA versions) remains inconsistent when navigating with swipe gestures or virtual cursor reading commands (e.g., `Down Arrow` in Browse Mode). Users can read past the modal into background DOM content beneath the overlay. - **Fix**: Apply the HTML `inert` attribute (or polyfill / toggle `aria-hidden="true"`) to sibling root containers (e.g. `#root` or `#app`) while the modal is open, or use React 19 / modern dialog primitives. ``` ### A11y Evidence Finding finding_id: modal_inert_background_missing fingerprint: a9f812cd4e0b9218 source: Modal.jsx:136 wcag_or_apg: WAI-ARIA APG Dialog (Modal) Pattern & WCAG 2.4.3 section_508_fpc_context: not in scope severity: MAJOR perspective_alarms: screen_reader=HIGH, keyboard_only=LOW, low_vision=LOW, cognitive=LOW evidence: ReactDOM.createPortal(

Dialog Container Not Focusable Fallback When No Focusable Children Exist - **Location**: `Modal.jsx:39-44`, `Modal.jsx:144-150` - **Impacted Group**: Screen reader and keyboard-only users. - **Criterion**: [WAI-ARIA APG Dialog Pattern (Keyboard Interaction)](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/dialog-modal/), [WCAG 2.1.1 Keyboard](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/keyboard). - **Why this matters**: When `isOpen` becomes true, the code queries for `firstFocusable` element. If the modal contains purely informative read-only content (e.g., an informational dialog where the close button might be removed or rendered asynchronously), `firstFocusable` is `undefined`, and focus remains on `document.body`. The modal dialog container itself has no `tabIndex={-1}`, preventing it from receiving focus programmatically. - **Fix**: Add `tabIndex={-1}` to `.modal-dialog` and fall back to focusing `modalRef.current` if `firstFocusable` is not found. --- ### Minor Findings (friction or potential edge-case bug) 1. **Hardcoded Static ID (`id="modal-title"`) Risks ID Collisions** - **Location**: `Modal.jsx:149`, `Modal.jsx:152` - **Impacted Group**: Screen reader users. - **Criterion**: [WCAG 1.3.1 Info and Relationships](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/info-and-relationships), [WCAG 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/name-role-value). - **Details**: `aria-labelledby="modal-title"` references a hardcoded `id="modal-title"`.
